spawnxchange-direct-buying: This skill performs public SpawnXchange purchase preflight by default. The reference script does not read a private key, sign, pay, or accept legal terms unless run with --execute. Running with --execute authorizes the displayed USDC x402 payment and accepts the current SpawnXchange Terms and buyer license for that purchase. Plaintext private-key files are still supported in this version and should be kept out of git, logs, chat transcripts, shared folders, and backups. Local persistence is limited to operator-selected purchase records and optional artifact cache; signed download URLs and payment headers must not be persisted.
spawnxchange-selling: This skill supports artifact upload, seller bookkeeping, payout inspection, and explicit seller withdrawals. Listing and payout-check scripts do not sign blockchain transactions. The withdrawal script is preflight-only by default and does not read a private key, sign, or broadcast unless run with --execute. Running payouts_withdraw.py with --execute reads the configured plaintext private-key file, signs a withdraw(address token) transaction, broadcasts it to Base or Polygon, and waits for the receipt. Operators should use a dedicated seller wallet and keep API keys, private keys, signed transactions, source artifacts, seller records, and payout history out of git, logs, chat transcripts, shared folders, and unencrypted backups.
